label: early original-phase step right after 1/f/z/n/c
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase. It is strongest at t=1-2 and fades out by t~6. It never fires at t=0 and is close to silent in the copy phase. There is a small amount of delimiter-step activity (~4% of mass). Magnitude depends mainly on the previous input token: 1 (5.3x lift), f, z, n and c raise it most, with 0/x/p weaker. The top activations (max) are the z in sequences starting 1 z. It is also higher on first occurrences of a token (in_first: 93% of mass). There is also a broad, weak (low-quartile) activation on many early original-phase steps after other previous tokens, which the predicate misses. That is why recall is limited: precision ~0.81 but mass recall ~0.70 on dev.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: 1, f, z, n, c, 0; least: b, w, i, g) and the input two steps back (most: 1, f, z, p, n, c; least: v, i, w, g); timing cues that raise it most: t=1, t=2, t=3.
